_comment: M-STRIPE-DEPOSIT test payloads. POST each variant individually to the scenario webhook URL. Use Stripe test mode keys during all staging/development tests. Replace the webhook URL with the one generated by Make after import.
_stripe_test_note: All amounts in cents (integer). Stripe minimum charge: 50 cents (5000 millicents). Test card: 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future expiry, any CVC.

A_happy_path_sss_miami._description: Full happy path — She Said Sail, Miami, $500 deposit. Verify: Stripe Payment Link created in test mode, Bookings record recBK0001 updated (Status=DEPOSIT_SENT, Deposit_Link, Stripe_Payment_Link_ID, Deposit_Sent_At, Deposit_Amount=500.00), Gmail deposit email sent to jessica.chen@email.com, SMS sent to +13055550101, audit DEPOSIT_LINK_SENT logged, Slack STRIPE_LINK_SENT alert fired.

B_happy_path_mare_executive_charleston._description: Happy path — Mare Executive, Charleston, $750 deposit. Tests brand-correct product naming on Stripe and email subject. Verify Stripe product name includes MARE_EXECUTIVE.

C_happy_path_sss_tampa._description: Happy path — She Said Sail, Tampa, $350 deposit. Verifies Tampa city and SMS formatting with non-Miami area code.

D_large_deposit_amount._description: High-value booking — $2,500 deposit. Tests that large cent values are handled correctly (no float rounding issues in Stripe or Airtable). Verify Deposit_Amount = 2500.00 in Airtable.

E_minimum_deposit_amount._description: Minimum viable deposit — $50.00 (5000 cents). Tests Stripe's minimum charge floor. Anything below 50 cents will cause a Stripe API error. Verify this passes the Stripe 50-cent minimum.

F_stripe_error_below_minimum._description: Error path — amount below Stripe minimum (40 cents). Module 4 (Stripe) should return a 400 error. Verify: error handler fires, SCENARIO_ERROR audit event logged, Slack error alert fired, Bookings record NOT updated, Stripe link NOT created.

G_invalid_booking_id._description: Error path — bogus Airtable record ID. Module 2 (ActionGetRecord on Bookings) should throw an error. Verify: error handler fires (modules 10-11), SCENARIO_ERROR audit event logged with error_module populated, Slack error alert in #sss-ops-alerts.

H_missing_package_name._description: Package not found — package_name does not match any Packages record. Module 3 returns empty results. Module 4 proceeds but Stripe product description will use a blank package description. Verify: flow completes, Stripe link created, email sent — inspect product name for graceful empty-field handling.

I_production_reference._description: Production-format reference payload. Replace all placeholder values with real data before sending. Set environment = production only when ready to charge a real client. Stripe must be in live mode.
